fakeValues.description: Every table value links: all IDs point at existing rows. Values the source does not have are either invented IDs (below) or "" (unknown). Replace an invented ID everywhere it appears once the real one is known; "lookups" describes each one.

patterns.FAKE-PUUID-<player>: Invented player PUUID (Players.PUUID, Teams player/sub columns, MatchParticipants.PUUID)
patterns.FAKE-GAME-<match>: Invented Riot match ID (Matches, MatchTeams, MatchParticipants "Game ID")
patterns.FORFEIT-<match>: Game ID of a forfeit; no game was played, so it has no MatchTeams or MatchParticipants rows

fakeValues.unknown: "" means unknown or not applicable: Tagline (77 players), Discord, Tournament Code (most matches), Start Timestamp, some Durations, First Blood, Inhibitors, Rift Herald, Barons, and stats/bans/champions the source did not record

conventions.teamIds: S2-T<roster number>. Team Infinity (7) is missing from the Rosters tab; 39–41 are schedule-only teams with invented placeholder players
conventions.matchKeys: S2-W<week>-M<order within the week on the Schedule tab>
conventions.sides: Blue/Red are the first/second team listed on the schedule; actual sides are unverified until the Game ID is known
conventions.championIds: Ban and Champion values are numeric Champions.ID values (Data Dragon keys)
conventions.duration: Seconds, from the Team Stats tab
conventions.positions: Player Stats columns 1–5 are treated as TOP, JUNGLE, MIDDLE, BOTTOM, UTILITY (column 5 has support-level CS, column 4 the most gold)
conventions.participantChampions: The source lists team picks without pairing them to players; pick n is assigned to the player in column n
conventions.participants: Who played each game is inferred where the source is ambiguous; see "assumptions" (type PARTICIPANTS)
conventions.participantColumns: MatchParticipants uses proposed column names; the live table still has placeholder columns (Column 1–14)
